summary: Flat clamping hub, a ring with a central 32 mm bore, four lobed mounting ears on a square pattern, and a split clamp block at the top. A cap screw across the slit tightens the clamp. Dimensions are scaled from the drawing views using the 32 mm bore as the reference.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front flat face of the ring and ears, used for mounting with the four holes on a 32 mm square pattern
Rear flat face of the ring and ears, which mirrors the front face

notes: The scale comes from the 32 mm bore (about 35.8 px/mm in the front views). Hole spacing measures about 32 mm in both directions. The bore center sits about 3.6 mm below the bbox center because the clamp block extends upward. The 8 mm thickness is a visual estimate from the isometric view and is not printed anywhere. The 4 mm mounting hole and 3 mm clamp-screw diameters are also estimates. The product data has no dimensions and is marked unverified. The clamp slit is about 2 mm wide and runs from the bore to the top edge at x=0.
